title: Shockwave, Laser, TECAR and PEMF — The Electrophysical Agents, Honestly

hook.en: Clinics buy machines because they look modern, patients are impressed by lights and beeps, and sales representatives promise fast healing. But a machine is only as good as the trials behind it. Some of these technologies have decent evidence for a few conditions; others have almost none. Here is the honest map.
hook.ur: Clinics machinein is liye khareedte hain ke jadeed lagti hain, mareez batiyon aur awazon se mutasir hote hain, aur sales representatives tez sehatyabi ka waada karte hain. Lekin machine utni hi achhi hai jitne uske peechay ke trials. In mein se kuch technologies ka kuch halaton ke liye theek saboot hai; doosri ka taqreeban koi nahi. Yeh imaandar naqsha hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll describe what extracorporeal shockwave therapy (ESWT), low-level laser, TECAR (capacitive-resistive diathermy) and pulsed electromagnetic field (PEMF) therapies are, say which conditions each has the best evidence for, recognise the typical weaknesses of device trials, and counsel patients about cost and expectations.
goal.ur: End tak aap bayan karenge ke extracorporeal shockwave therapy (ESWT), low-level laser, TECAR (capacitive-resistive diathermy) aur pulsed electromagnetic field (PEMF) therapies kya hain, batayenge har ek ka kin halaton ke liye sab se behtar saboot hai, device trials ki aam kamzoriyan pehchanenge, aur kharch aur umeedon par mareezon ko mashwara denge.

text.en: These are **electrophysical agents**: devices that deliver energy to tissue, with the hope of reducing pain or speeding healing. **ESWT** sends acoustic pressure pulses into tissue and has the best evidence for **plantar heel pain** and **calcific shoulder tendinopathy**; for tennis elbow and other tendons the results are mixed. **Low-level laser** (photobiomodulation) delivers light at low power and may reduce pain in some conditions, but results depend heavily on dose and quality of trial. **TECAR** (a form of deep heating with radiofrequency) and **PEMF** have mostly small, short or poorly controlled studies. For all, the effect is usually a **small add-on**, not a cure.
text.ur: Yeh **electrophysical agents** hain: aise aale jo tissue ko tawanai pohanchate hain, dard kam karne ya sehatyabi tez karne ki ummeed mein. **ESWT** tissue mein acoustic dabao ki lehrein bhejta hai aur **ediyon ke dard (plantar heel pain)** aur **kandhe ki calcific tendinopathy** ke liye sab se behtar saboot rakhta hai; tennis elbow aur doosre tendons ke liye nateeje mile-jule hain. **Low-level laser** (photobiomodulation) kam taqat ki roshni deta hai aur kuch halaton mein dard kam kar sakta hai, lekin nateeje dose aur trial ki quality par bohat munhasir hain. **TECAR** (radiofrequency se gehri garmi ki ek shakl) aur **PEMF** ke zyada tar chhote, mukhtasar ya kam control shuda studies hain. Sab ke liye asar aam taur par **chhota izafa** hai, ilaaj nahi.

text.en: Think of **a new kitchen gadget** in a shop demo. It looks impressive, but it may only do a little better than the old knife, and some gadgets do nothing the knife cannot do. Before buying, you ask: who tested it, against what, and how much better was it? The same questions apply to physiotherapy machines.
text.ur: Dukaan ke demo mein **naya kitchen gadget** sochein. Woh mutasir-kun lagta hai, lekin purani chhuri se shayad thora hi behtar ho, aur kuch gadgets woh kuch nahi karte jo chhuri na kar sake. Khareedne se pehle aap poochhte hain: kis ne test kiya, kis ke muqabale mein, aur kitna behtar tha? Physiotherapy ki machinon par bhi wahi sawal lagu hote hain.

title.en: Four technologies and the evidence for each
title.ur: Chaar technologies aur har ek ka saboot

rows.en: Pressure pulses stimulate tissue repair and modulate pain
rows.ur: Dabao ki lehrein tissue ki marammat ko tahreek aur dard ko modulate karti hain

rows.en: Best for plantar heel pain and calcific shoulder tendinopathy; mixed for tennis elbow, patellar and Achilles tendons; can be painful during treatment
rows.ur: Plantar heel pain aur kandhe ki calcific tendinopathy ke liye behtar; tennis elbow, patellar aur Achilles tendons ke liye mila-jula; ilaaj ke dauran dardnak ho sakta hai

rows.en: Light energy reduces inflammation and pain
rows.ur: Roshni ki tawanai soojan aur dard kam karti hai

rows.en: Some trials show pain reduction, especially in acute pain and some neck, knee and tendon conditions; results depend on dose, wavelength and trial quality
rows.ur: Kuch trials dard mein kami dikhate hain, khaaskar acute dard aur gardan, ghutne aur tendon ki kuch halaton mein; nateeje dose, wavelength aur trial ki quality par munhasir

rows.en: Radiofrequency deep heating to improve circulation and relax tissue
rows.ur: Radiofrequency gehri garmi gardish behtar aur tissue dheela karne ke liye

rows.en: Small, short or poorly controlled studies; benefits for pain and function are unproven
rows.ur: Chhote, mukhtasar ya kam control shuda studies; dard aur function ke faide sabit nahi

rows.en: Fields stimulate cell activity, bone healing and pain relief
rows.ur: Fields cell ki activity, haddi ki sehatyabi aur dard ke aaram ko tahreek dete hain

rows.en: Some small trials in osteoarthritis and bone healing; evidence is inconsistent and of low quality
rows.ur: Osteoarthritis aur haddi ki sehatyabi mein kuch chhote trials; saboot be-tarteeb aur kam quality ka

question.en: A clinic offers a new TECAR machine at 3,000 rupees per session for any muscle pain, saying it "regenerates tissue". What is the most reasonable response?
question.ur: Clinic naya TECAR machine har muscle dard ke liye 3,000 rupay per session par pesh karta hai, kehta hai yeh "tissue ko dobara paida karta hai". Sab se munasib jawab kya hai?

text.en: Accept the claim because the machine is new and expensive
text.ur: Daawa maan lein kyunke machine nayi aur mehngi hai

feedback.en: Price and novelty are not evidence.

text.en: Say the machine is dangerous and refuse all electrotherapy
text.ur: Kahein machine khatarnak hai aur har electrotherapy radd karein

feedback.ur: Yeh khatre ko barha kar kehta hai.

text.en: Ask for the controlled trials: the evidence for TECAR is limited, so exercise and education should remain the core, and any use should be optional and affordable
text.ur: Controlled trials maangein: TECAR ka saboot mehdood hai, isliye exercise aur taleem asal rehni chahiye, aur koi bhi istemal ikhtiyari aur affordable ho

feedback.en: Yes — limited evidence and high cost call for caution.
feedback.ur: Haan — mehdood saboot aur zyada kharch ehtiyat maangte hain.

question.en: Which condition has among the better evidence for shockwave therapy?
question.ur: Kis halat ke liye shockwave therapy ka sab se behtar saboot hai?

text.en: Plantar heel pain, and calcific shoulder tendinopathy
text.ur: Ediyon ka dard (plantar heel pain), aur kandhe ki calcific tendinopathy

feedback.en: Yes — these are the conditions with the most supportive trials.
feedback.ur: Haan — in halaton ke liye sab se zyada himayati trials hain.

question.en: A device trial reports that "patients improved significantly" but had no sham group and the therapist who applied the device also measured the outcome. What is the main weakness?
question.ur: Device trial report karta hai ke "mareez nihayat behtar hue" lekin sham group nahi tha aur jis therapist ne device lagayi usi ne nateeja naapa. Sab se badi kamzori kya hai?

text.ur: Devices ka study nahi ho sakta

feedback.ur: Ho sakta hai, sahi design ke saath.

text.en: No sham control and no masked assessor, so placebo, expectation and bias can explain the improvement
text.ur: Sham control aur masked assessor nahi, isliye placebo, umeed aur bias behtari ki wazahat kar sakte hain

feedback.en: Yes — device trials need sham controls and masking.
feedback.ur: Haan — device trials ko sham controls aur masking chahiye.

text.en: **Buying the machine first and finding the evidence later.** Many devices enter clinics because of marketing, not trials, and then patients are charged for sessions that add little. Ask for independent controlled trials with sham devices, check whether the studied dose is the one the machine delivers, and always protect the basics of care: assessment, education, graded loading and a clear plan. A device is an optional extra, never the core treatment.
text.ur: **Pehle machine khareedna aur baad mein saboot dhoondhna.** Bohat se devices marketing ki wajah se clinics mein aate hain, trials ki wajah se nahi, aur phir mareezon se aise sessions ka paisa liya jata hai jo thora hi izafa karte hain. Sham devices ke saath azaad controlled trials maangein, dekhein ke jo dose study hui kya machine wohi deti hai, aur care ki bunyadiyat hamesha mehfooz rakhein: assessment, taleem, darja-ba-darja loading aur saaf plan. Device ikhtiyari izafa hai, asal ilaaj kabhi nahi.

text.en: **Use a "device decision" card.** Before offering a machine, write: the condition, the best evidence for it, the expected size and duration of benefit, the cost per session and the total, the contraindications, and what you will do if it does not help in 3 to 4 sessions. Share this with the patient and let them choose. If the evidence is thin, say so, and offer cheaper options such as loading and education first.
text.ur: **"Device ke faisle" ka card istemal karein.** Machine pesh karne se pehle likhein: halat, is ke liye behtareen saboot, faide ka mutawaqqe size aur muddat, per session aur kul kharch, contraindications, aur agar 3 se 4 sessions mein faida na ho to aap kya karenge. Mareez se share karein aur unhein chunne dein. Agar saboot kam ho to batayein, aur pehle loading aur taleem jaise sasti options dein.

question.en: Why do device trials so often disagree?
question.ur: Device trials aksar ek doosre se mukhtalif kyun hote hain?

answer.en: The dose is hard to standardise: energy, frequency, area, number of sessions and patient positioning vary. Blinding is difficult because patients feel shockwave, and sham settings may not be convincing. Many trials are small and some are funded by manufacturers, which is linked to more favourable results. Different conditions respond differently, so a result for one tendon cannot be applied to another. Reading reviews with risk-of-bias ratings helps.
answer.ur: Dose ko mayaari banana mushkil hai: tawanai, frequency, hissa, sessions ki ginti aur mareez ki position mukhtalif hoti hain. Blinding mushkil hai kyunke mareez shockwave mehsoos karte hain, aur sham settings qaail kar-ne wali na hon. Bohat se trials chhote hain aur kuch ko banane walon ki funding milti hai, jo zyada musbat nateejon se juda hai. Mukhtalif halatein mukhtalif jawab deti hain, isliye ek tendon ka nateeja doosre par lagu nahi ho sakta. Risk-of-bias ki ratings wale reviews parhna madad karta hai.

beats.patient: A runner with chronic plantar heel pain for eight months has tried stretching and insoles. He asks about shockwave therapy at 4,000 rupees per session for five sessions.
beats.assessment: Shockwave has some of its best evidence in plantar heel pain, so it is a reasonable option, with realistic expectations.
beats.treatment: The therapist explains that benefit is moderate and takes weeks, that treatment can be uncomfortable, and that loading exercises, load management and calf strengthening remain the core. He agrees to a trial of three sessions with a review.
beats.reassess: At six weeks his pain is lower; the therapist and patient agree that shockwave helped a little and the exercises helped more, and they stop after the third session.

text.en: **Check contraindications and set limits.** Avoid shockwave over fractures that are not healed, tumours, infections, pregnancy, growth plates in children, air-filled tissue such as lung, and in people with bleeding disorders or on anticoagulants without advice. Avoid laser near the eyes and over tumours, and use eye protection. Heating devices should not be used over areas of reduced sensation, poor circulation, metal implants (for some devices), pacemakers, or in pregnancy. Follow the manufacturer's guidance and local rules, and stop if pain or skin changes occur.
text.ur: **Contraindications dekhein aur hadein tay karein.** Na jure hue fractures, tumours, infections, hamal, bachon ke growth plates, hawa wale tissue jaise phephra, aur khoon ki bimariyon ya anticoagulants wale logon mein mashwara ke baghair shockwave se bachein. Aankhon ke paas aur tumours par laser se bachein, aur aankhon ki hifazat istemal karein. Garmi dene wale devices kam hissi, kam gardish, dhaat ke implants (kuch devices ke liye), pacemakers wale hisson par ya hamal mein istemal na karein. Banane wale ki rehnumai aur muqami qaide follow karein, aur dard ya jild ki tabdeeli par ruk jayein.

text.en: A systematic review of studies listed in the PEDro database on extracorporeal shock wave therapy for orthopaedic conditions found moderate to strong evidence of effectiveness for some conditions, such as calcific shoulder tendinopathy and plantar heel pain, with lower or inconsistent evidence for others, and noted that many studies were of varying methodological quality. A systematic review of low-level laser therapy in acute pain found that, when adequate doses were used, laser could reduce acute pain in randomised placebo-controlled trials, and discussed possible mechanisms, while noting that effects depend on dose and parameters.
text.ur: PEDro database mein darj orthopaedic halaton ke liye extracorporeal shock wave therapy ke studies ke ek systematic review ne kuch halaton, jaise kandhe ki calcific tendinopathy aur plantar heel pain, ke liye asar ka darmiyana se mazboot saboot paya, jabke doosri halaton ke liye kam ya be-tarteeb saboot, aur likha ke bohat se studies ki methodological quality mukhtalif thi. Acute dard mein low-level laser therapy ke ek systematic review ne paya ke munasib doses istemal hone par laser randomised placebo-controlled trials mein acute dard kam kar sakta tha, aur mumkina tareeqa-e-kaar par baat ki, jabke yeh bhi likha ke asar dose aur parameters par munhasir hai.

text.en: **Condition, Dose, Sham, Cost.** Which condition, what dose, was there a sham, and what does it cost?
text.ur: **Halat, Dose, Sham, Kharch.** Kaun si halat, kaun si dose, kya sham tha, aur kharch kya hai?

summary.en: ESWT has the best evidence for plantar heel pain and calcific shoulder tendinopathy; laser is dose-dependent; TECAR and PEMF have limited evidence.
summary.ur: ESWT ka plantar heel pain aur kandhe ki calcific tendinopathy ke liye behtar saboot hai; laser dose par munhasir hai; TECAR aur PEMF ka saboot mehdood hai.

summary.en: Device trials often lack sham controls and masking, so ask for independent, well-controlled studies.
summary.ur: Device trials mein aksar sham controls aur masking nahi hoti, isliye azaad, achhi tarah control shuda studies maangein.

summary.en: Use devices as optional extras with clear cost, expectations and contraindications, never in place of loading and education.
summary.ur: Devices ko saaf kharch, umeedon aur contraindications ke saath ikhtiyari izafe ke taur par istemal karein, loading aur taleem ki jagah kabhi nahi.

front.en: For which conditions is shockwave evidence strongest?
front.ur: Shockwave ka saboot kin halaton ke liye sab se mazboot hai?

back.en: Plantar heel pain and calcific shoulder tendinopathy.
back.ur: Plantar heel pain aur kandhe ki calcific tendinopathy.

back.en: A form of radiofrequency deep heating (capacitive-resistive diathermy).
back.ur: Radiofrequency gehri garmi ki ek shakl (capacitive-resistive diathermy).

front.ur: Laser ki dose kyun ahem hai?

back.en: Too little or too much energy can give no effect; results depend on parameters.
back.ur: Bohat kam ya zyada tawanai koi asar nahi de sakti; nateeje parameters par munhasir hain.

front.en: What weakness is common in device trials?
front.ur: Device trials mein aam kamzori kya hai?

back.en: No sham control, no masking, small samples or manufacturer funding.
back.ur: Sham control nahi, masking nahi, chhote samples ya banane walon ki funding.
